limitations: Hidden-state logic is simulated; browser freezing/discarding is outside this harness.
Fixtures do not establish current live-site markup, CSP, script-manager, or media-codec compatibility.
The original baseline receives a valid legacy review response to isolate pipeline work from endpoint retirement.

scope: Generated artifacts and isolated test browsers; public live Steam provider checks. No browser installation, push or publication. Shared test counts include repeated engine scenarios.
